coreLoop: Start immediately with simple one-thumb tap or swipe input and a clear score, distance, or short-session goal.
Play a brief run with readable feedback, collect rewards, and make a small risk or route choice before the run ends.
Finish or fail, receive a score or reward, unlock a small progression benefit, and retry quickly with minimal friction.
content.progressionDirection: Simple, iterative gameplay loop with clear goals and rewards.
content.visualDirection: Stylized, slightly whimsical 2D graphics.  A focus on a vibrant, slightly overgrown world.
content.marketTargetDirection: Design Baseline, Casual, Puzzle, and Adventure.
content.steamExpansionDecision: Single-player, casual, puzzle-focused, with a focus on a compelling world and challenging gameplay.
